description: This file defines the WrappingMessageMapper class, which is a final class implementing the MessageMapper interface. It wraps another MessageMapper to enforce message size limits and add correlation IDs. It provides methods for configuration, mapping messages, and accessing internal components, with exception handling for message limit violations.

classes.name: WrappingMessageMapper
classes.description: A final class implementing MessageMapper that wraps another MessageMapper to enforce message size limits and add correlation IDs during message mapping processes.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Static factory method that wraps a given MessageMapper with WrappingMessageMapper.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the delegate MessageMapper.

methods.name: getContentTypeBlocklist
methods.description: Returns the blocklisted content types from the delegate.

methods.name: getDefaultOptions
methods.description: Returns default options JsonObject from the delegate.

methods.name: getIncomingConditions
methods.description: Returns incoming conditions map from the delegate.

methods.name: getOutgoingConditions
methods.description: Returns outgoing conditions map from the delegate.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the mapper with provided MappingConfig and MessageMapperConfiguration, setting message size limits.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps an ExternalMessage or Adaptable to a List of Adaptable or ExternalMessage, enforcing message limits and adding correlation IDs.
